_comment: A filled-in delivery job request — POST /api/foodpanda/jobs on 8103, or
POST /api/delivery/jobs on 8102. One wire format for both, which is what
makes DELIVERY_PROVIDER a config change rather than a code change.
In normal operation nothing hand-writes this: authorize_payment hands a paid
take-away order over on its own, and the ordering agent has no step for it.
This is here for reading a request that failed, and for calling a courier
order.paid must be true (409 otherwise) and order.items must be non-empty
(422 otherwise). Both are checked at the edge rather than left to the
dispatcher, because neither is a judgement call.
whereItGoes says the customer already asked for this to be brought to them.
It pre-answers the second gate only, is accepted as where_it_goes too, and
absent reads as false — the behaviour this service has always had.
